sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 425 numbered subject rows / 395 family-card identities and 86 unnumbered artists across 24 sections are reconciled against original PDF text-object columns. The 100 BASE entries and 35 30 YEARS AND BEYOND entries are separate programs; the numeric-leading heading is a caption. Character/Property and First Name/Last Name/Character cells remain separate, including repeated dual signers, three image-variation 25 entries and Tinny’s printed Toy Story 2 variation property. All 104 Hobby odds and literal values are preserved; no ratio unit is named. The guide supplies 47 exact family limits: 42 join existing odds and five remain specification-only, without invented ratios. Guide-only autograph example spellings, store availability and box contents remain qualified. A general release date and exhaustive parallel coverage remain unverified.
Sid Has Your Cards Black /10, Red /5 and Superfractor 1/1 are guide-only specifications without separate odds rows; do not fabricate ratios.
The dual-autograph guide names Woody’s Cowboy Hat Shimmer /99 and Gold Refractor /50; neither is a separate category in this odds PDF. Keep both specification-only.
The odds sheet names Hobby without a ratio unit. Box contents do not establish per-pack units or probabilities for these ratios.
No odds row is explicitly joined to Executive Studio Creations Sketch Card; the separately named Studio Creations row is not silently extended to it.
Numbering for other families and exhaustive parallel reconciliation remain unverified; matching colors never establish numbering across families.
A general calendar release date remains unverified; keep store Available From May 6, 2026 and Product Year 2026 separate from the 2025 checklist title.
